claims: The game was a 2026 NCAA Women’s Tournament First Four matchup on March 19, 2026
The game was at Carver-Hawkeye Arena, Iowa City, IA
Kymora Johnson scored 17 points for Virginia
Kymora Johnson had 10 rebounds for Virginia
Kymora Johnson made a go-ahead 3-pointer with 30 seconds left
Caitlin Weimar scored 11 points for Virginia
Romi Levy scored 10 points for Virginia
Marley Washenitz scored 19 points for Arizona State
McKinna Brackens scored 10 points for Arizona State
McKinna Brackens had 10 rebounds for Arizona State
Heloisa Carrera scored 10 points for Arizona State
Arizona State erased a late deficit with a 3-pointer from Marley Washenitz
Kymora Johnson answered immediately with a 3-pointer to take the lead for good
Arizona State turned the ball over in the final seconds
Virginiasports.com notes that this was Virginia's first NCAA Tournament win since 2018
